title: Introduction
description: Understand what tempjs does, how client projects are created, and the path from install to a running site.

blocks.text: tempjs is a command-line tool that copies a complete, production-oriented website into your folder — not a skeleton with missing pieces, but a full Next.js app with admin panel, database layer, and deployment-ready structure. You use it when you need to spin up a client site (hotel, real estate, or future verticals) without rebuilding shared features like lead capture, admin auth, or Docker database setup from scratch every time.
What happens when you run tempjs?

Think of it in three layers. First, the CLI resolves a template package (from npm or GitHub) and copies files flat into your current directory — no nested template folder. Second, it writes .tempjs.json, a stamp that records which template version you used so you can compare updates later. Third, optionally, it runs setup: theme colors, fonts, brand/contact fields in constants/site.ts, and database credentials in .env. After that, you own the project — edit code, deploy, and customize like any Next.js app.

blocks.title: Who this guide is for
blocks.text: Developers who install tempjs via npm and generate client websites. You do not need the templates monorepo unless you maintain templates themselves.
Install globally so tempjs is available in any client folder. list shows template ids you can use as commands (e.g. hotel, real-estate).
Each step below is intentional — skipping one often causes confusion later.

items: Create an empty folder for the client — this becomes the project root (tempjs does not create a subfolder for you).
Run tempjs <template-id> — use config for guided setup, or flags for automation (see template pages for the command builder).
pnpm install — dependencies are not installed by the CLI; the template expects pnpm.
Configure .env — copy .env.example or use tempjs init-db; DATABASE_URL and ADMIN_* must exist before Prisma works.
Start MariaDB — docker compose up -d is the usual local path; then pnpm prisma db push && pnpm prisma db seed.
pnpm dev — open /admin with credentials from .env; use GET /api/health to verify database connectivity.
Customize constants/site.ts for copy, images, and colors; deploy when ready.
Later: tempjs update --check in the project folder to see if the upstream template has fixes you can merge.

blocks.title: Docs inside the generated project
blocks.text: Every template ships GETTING_STARTED.md (linear checklist), ARCHITECTURE.md (how the app is structured), and README in the client folder after generation. Start there when onboarding a teammate.

tempjs hotel config asks questions in the terminal — good for first-time setup. tempjs hotel --config --yes --name "..." --db-host localhost ... runs the same steps without prompts, which is what you want in scripts or when you already know every value. Template pages include a command generator that builds the non-interactive command for you field by field.
